2607.26899.title: Human diversity fuels collective creativity that large language models cannot simulate or sustain
2607.26899.paper_summary: Diverse human groups produce diverse ideas, the raw material of innovation. Generative AI challenges this engine twice over: everyday AI assistance may homogenize what diverse people create, and AI-simulated diversity may replace the people altogether. We tested both challenges in a preregistered creative metaphor experiment with native (L1) and non-native (L2) English writers, who wrote without AI, with AI-generated ideas (AI ideation), or with AI refining their own ideas (AI refinement). L2 writers contributed more collective diversity than L1 writers, with native-language ideation showing the most diverse pools. AI ideation compressed collective diversity for everyone and left the L2 advantage undetectable, whereas AI refinement preserved both. We then simulated the entire writer pool using personas built from participants' real backgrounds, three model families, native-language prompting, and elevated sampling temperatures. Every simulated pool fell below every human pool, and pushing models further induced diversity only through degenerate text. However, at the individual level, AI ideation raised writers' ratings, pitting private incentives against the collective good, except when L2 writers used their native language, which benefited both. Human diversity remains a valuable creative resource that current AI cannot simulate or sustain; the design of human-AI collaborative workflows determines whether it survives.
2607.26899.paper_summary_zh: 多樣的人類群體產生多樣的想法，這是創新的原材料。生成式AI對這一引擎提出了兩重挑戰：日常的AI協助可能會使多樣的人所創造的東西同質化，而AI模擬的多樣性可能會完全取代這些人。我們在一項預註冊的創意隱喻實驗中測試了這兩個挑戰，參與者包括母語（L1）和非母語（L2）英語寫作者，他們在沒有AI的情況下、使用AI生成的想法（AI構思）或使用AI精煉自己的想法（AI精煉）進行寫作。L2寫作者貢獻了比L1寫作者更多的集體多樣性，母語構思顯示出最具多樣性的池子。AI構思壓縮了每個人的集體多樣性，並使L2的優勢無法檢測，而AI精煉則保留了兩者。我們隨後使用基於參與者真實背景構建的人物角色模擬了整個寫作者池，三個模型家庭、母語提示和提高的取樣溫度。每個模擬池的多樣性都低於每個人類池，進一步推進模型只通過退化文本引發多樣性。然而，在個體層面上，AI構思提升了寫作者的評分，使私人激勵與集體利益相對立，除了當L2寫作者使用他們的母語時，這對雙方都有利。人類多樣性仍然是一種寶貴的創意資源，當前的AI無法模擬或維持；人類與AI協作工作流程的設計決定了它是否能夠存活。
2607.26899.author: Mengchen Dong et.al.
